references.text: Jesus also speaks here about some of those standing there not tasting death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom, which parallels seeing the kingdom of God come with power.
Similar to Jesus' words that some will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God, pointing to an imminent manifestation of the kingdom of God.
Refers to God's glory and power revealed on Mount Sinai, which can be seen as a foretaste of the kingdom of God manifested in power.
The prophecy about the Lord's day, coming with power and glory, can be viewed in light of Jesus' words about seeing the kingdom of God come in power.
Daniel's vision of the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven can be connected to the expectation of seeing the kingdom of God manifested in power.
